text:
Aisha: Heads-up: the "mini-next-llamaindex" starter is flaking on edge preview. Repro steps in thread.
Liam: repro?
Aisha: Clone https://github.com/redwood/sample-next-llama, npm i, set RW_KEY, deploy to Vercel as Edge. The LlamaIndex ingestion page 500s intermittently, and SDK telemetry shows gaps.
Keiko: Which SDK + sample commit?
Aisha: sdk@0.9.0, sample commit 7f3a2d. Happens locally with vercel dev --edge too.
Rafael: Any stack traces?
Aisha: Short: 
```
TypeError: Failed to fetch telemetry: no global fetch in this runtime
    at sendTelemetry (/workspace/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.js:120:15)
    at handleRequest (pages/api/ingest.edge.js:34:5)
```
Liam: So edge runtime complaining about global fetch — Next edge uses native fetch but our bundle might be expecting node-fetch shim.
Keiko: Also saw auth refresh races. First request after token refresh returns 401 then subsequent request passes. Might be race between cached token write and next invocation.
Aisha: I added logging; the refresh flow is called, but the cached token isn't visible to the same edge invocation (probably because runtime isolates each request).
Rafael: Workarounds?
Keiko: We could update sample to use server runtime for ingestion route and show a separate edge demo for SSR only. But customers want a single edge-first starter.
Liam: SDK fixable: make auth storage abstracted to accept request-scoped storage or provide an in-memory fallback that returns consistent token during the invocation. Also guard telemetry send when fetch is missing; fall back to queue-and-flush at end-of-request.
QA-bot: Created flaky test ticket QA-1248: "edge ingestion 500s - missing fetch + auth race".
Aisha: Pasted minimal failing handler to the ticket: 
```js
import { init, ingest } from '@redwood/sdk'
export default async function handler(req) {
  await init({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
  // ingest uses internal telemetry + auth
  return await ingest(req.body)
}
```
Rafael: Note the await init(...) is important. If people call init() without await in edge, cold-start can continue before SDK ready. We should update docs/sample to show await pattern.
Keiko: I'll open a small sample PR to change the handler + add comment about edge caveats. Rafael, can you look at making auth storage pluggable?
Rafael: Yep, will prototype a request-scoped storage interface in SDK and add tests.
Aisha: Thanks. I'll try the sample with await init and report back.
devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-1902 assigned to @Keiko and @Rafael.
